== Biography ==
Hadassah was born about 1776. She was the daughter of [[Glasgow-12|Robert Glasgow]] and [[Barclay-56|Rosana Barclay]].  She passed away in 1846. 
=== Parentage ===

David Faris's dedicated genealogy of [[Glasgow-12|Robert Glasgow]] and [[Barclay-56|Rosanna Barclay]] identifies '''Hadassah Esther Glasgow''' among their ten children. This family reconstruction agrees with the migration and sibling evidence summarized on Robert's profile, so both parent relationships are treated as confident.
